Line.zh: 他询问你需要什么样的伙伴。
Line.en: He asks you to describe what kind of partner you are looking for.
Line.ja: He asks you to describe what kind of partner you are looking for.

name.zh: 他说他会试着找到这么个人，下次来的时候带上他。如果你改变主意了得告诉他。
name.en: He says he will try to find such a person for his next forest visit, and that you should let him know if you change your mind.
